What makes "Concealed Weapon" wallpaper is the limitations on the card,
because
for the same cost "Disguised Weapon" has no limitations and is therefore
vastly
superior.

However, if "Concealed Weapon" were a combat modifier only usable at
the beginning of a round before range is chosen (and didn't require
obfuscate or any discipline for that matter) it would then serve a
purpose in somebodys deck.

-- Bernie

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Nathan Harada <an64...@anon.penet.fi> writes:

>>JoeHallie wrote:
>>
>> our group plays this card displineless if that's a word

>Ours doesn't. From a game point of view, it takes some of the
>power away from Obfuscate and Concealed Weapon. Why should non-
>Obfuscate clans get to pull out Sengir Daggers and Ivory Bows?

Because even Kine can *conceal* a small weapon on his person.
Because you don't need any special skill to conceal a weapon.

(Which is another reason for the restriction on the type of
weapon concealed - the restriction on damage and cost is an
attempt at limiting the size of the weapon concealed - you can
conceal a dagger or pistol, but not a flame thrower or RPG)
